_comment: Tier-0 mock dialogue templates (gdd-npc-dialogue.md §13.9). Keyed by move -> outcome -> attitude-band, with a per-move default and a global fallback. Because must_say content is engine-generated (NpcReplyPlan), these are informationally complete (§13.9). Slots: {npc_name}, {speaker_name}, {new_attitude}. The renderer (DialogueTemplateProvider) fills slots from the reply plan. Terse by design; the game is fully playable offline on these.

shared.any: {npc_name} leans in. "Here's a thing worth knowing: {rumor_text}"

default.any: {npc_name} considers, then shares what they've heard.

shift_toward_friendly.indifferent: {npc_name} relents a little. "Perhaps we can deal."

shift_toward_hostile.hostile: {npc_name}'s face darkens. "You've said the wrong thing."

no_change.any: {npc_name} is unmoved. Their manner is unchanged ({new_attitude}).

shift_toward_friendly.cowed: {npc_name} pales and submits. "Whatever you say — just don't hurt me."
shift_toward_friendly.fearful: {npc_name} flinches, eyes darting for the exit.

shift_toward_hostile.hostile: {npc_name} bares teeth. "Threaten me? Then we're done talking."

to_hostile.hostile: {npc_name} snaps. "That's the last insult I'll take from you!" — and reaches for a weapon.

no_knowledge.any: {npc_name} spreads their hands. "On that, I can't help you."

not_trusted.any: {npc_name} shakes their head. "I don't know you well enough to speak of that."

wants_payment.any: {npc_name} rubs thumb and fingers together. "Knowledge like that has a price."

refused.any: {npc_name}'s mouth sets in a line. "I'll not speak of it."

bribed.any: {npc_name} pockets the coin, manner easing. "Well — since you ask so kindly."

accept_elan.any: {npc_name} grins and clasps {speaker_name}'s hand. "Aye — gladly! When do we ride?"

accept.any: {npc_name} nods. "Your terms suit me. I'll take service."

try_again.any: {npc_name} hesitates. "Sweeten the deal and we'll talk."

refuse.any: {npc_name} shakes their head. "Not on those terms."

refuse_slander.any: {npc_name} sneers and turns away. "I'd not serve the likes of you — and I'll say as much to any who ask."

accept.any: {npc_name} inclines their head. "Agreed. My services are yours."

try_again.any: {npc_name} purses their lips. "The fee will need to be higher."

refuse_slander.any: {npc_name} bristles. "I'll not work for you — and others will hear why."

accept_elan.any: {npc_name} the captain slaps the table. "My company's yours — and glad of the work!"

accept.any: {npc_name} the captain nods. "We'll take your coin and your contract."

try_again.any: {npc_name} the captain folds their arms. "My lads won't march for that. Better terms."

refuse_slander.any: {npc_name} spits. "We don't soldier for the likes of you."

default.any: {speaker_name} makes the rounds, listening for word worth having.

offered.any: {npc_name} lowers their voice. "As it happens, there's {quest_title}, if you're the sort who takes such work."

none_available.any: {npc_name} shakes their head. "No work for you just now."

default.any: {npc_name} considers whether there's anything worth asking of {speaker_name}.

accepted.any: {npc_name} nods, satisfied. "Then it's settled — {quest_title} is yours. {reward_summary} on completion."

declined.any: {npc_name} shrugs. "Suit yourself. The offer stands if you change your mind."

turned_in.any: {npc_name} claps {speaker_name} on the shoulder. "Done, and done well. Here — {reward_summary}, as promised."

not_ready.any: {npc_name} raises an eyebrow. "It's not finished yet. Come back when it is."

granted.any: {npc_name} weighs it, then agrees. "Very well — I'll see to it. {detail}"

negotiable.any: {npc_name} tilts their head. "Perhaps. Make it worth my while and we'll talk."

refused_offended.any: {npc_name}'s expression hardens. "You dare ask that of me?"

persuaded.any: The ruler inclines their head slowly. "You argue well. I will reconsider my course. {detail}"

refused.any: The ruler is unmoved. "My decision stands."

reserved.any: The ruler frowns. "You ask me to march to war on your word? That is not a thing I will do lightly — nor now."

cowed.any: The enemy commander's shoulders fall. "Enough. We yield — spare my soldiers."

partial.any: The commander spits. "You'll get no surrender. Form up!"

collapse.any: The commander draws steel. "Insolent dogs — at them, NOW!"

refused.any: The commander holds the line. "We stand. Do your worst."

default.any: The opposing commander weighs the demand.

cowed.any: The commander grimaces and signals for the coffers. "Take your tribute and be gone."

partial.any: The commander scoffs. "Not a copper. We fight."

collapse.any: The commander roars a charge — the parley is over.

refused.any: The commander refuses. "We owe you nothing."

default.any: The commander considers the demand for tribute.

cowed.any: The commander nods, relieved. "Safe passage, then. We've no quarrel worth this."

partial.any: The commander hesitates, then declines. "No. We hold the road."

collapse.any: The commander takes the offer as weakness and attacks.

default.any: The commander weighs the offer of passage.

cowed.any: The commander clasps {speaker_name}'s forearm. "Agreed. We withdraw on these terms."

partial.any: The commander shakes their head. "Not enough. We'll settle this in the field."

collapse.any: The commander answers the terms with a war-cry.

default.any: The commander studies the terms {speaker_name} lays out.

ability_used.any: The air tightens as {speaker_name} works the effect. {detail}

resisted.any: {npc_name} shakes it off, eyes narrowing. "I felt that. What did you just try?"

combat.any: {npc_name} recoils as the magic gathers — and the room erupts into violence.

agreed.any: {npc_name}, disarmed and spent, sags. "Fine. Ransom, then — {detail}. Just let us live."

negotiable.any: {npc_name} bargains from their knees. "That's too much. Be reasonable."

refused.any: {npc_name} sets their jaw. "I'll die before I pay that."
